title: Subtract: Bring Forth More by Removing Obstacles
coreMove: Find the obstacle that slows the whole system and remove it before asking people to push harder.
sourcePressure: The chapter teaches constraint removal through the slowest hiker idea: identify the bottleneck that controls throughput instead of adding effort everywhere.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: A weak run would write about simplifying tasks or removing distractions rather than locating the controlling constraint.

hook: generic subtract: bring forth more by removing obstacles topic opener
tryThisNow: set a timer for ninety seconds...
make a list of priorities without a trade-off
generic say no to one thing today

exampleSpecs.domain: trail crew finding the slowest hiker in a bridge-repair supply chain
exampleSpecs.audience: crew lead seeing everyone work hard
exampleSpecs.stakes: progress is governed by the one missing hinge shipment
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: She maps three steps, finds hinges as the bottleneck, and stops adding carpenters until delivery changes.
exampleSpecs.firstImage: A bridge plank stack sits beside a missing-hinge list.

exampleSpecs.domain: hospital discharge team locating the pharmacy bottleneck
exampleSpecs.audience: team tempted to hurry every department
exampleSpecs.stakes: one prescription queue controls bed turnover
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: He times each handoff and removes duplicate pharmacy approval before asking nurses to move faster.
exampleSpecs.firstImage: A discharge board shows stalled prescription icons.

exampleSpecs.domain: podcast network discovering artwork approval blocks episode releases
exampleSpecs.stakes: editing faster will not help if artwork approval controls release
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: She lays episode cards in order and marks the artwork column where every card stalls.
exampleSpecs.firstImage: Episode cards pile up under an artwork approval column.

exampleSpecs.domain: food co-op checkout line slowed by produce code lookup
exampleSpecs.audience: operations lead seeing the true constraint
exampleSpecs.stakes: adding cashiers misses the repeated lookup delay
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Before, she schedules more cashiers; after, she moves produce code cards to the scale and the line clears.
exampleSpecs.firstImage: Produce code cards sit beside a checkout scale.

exampleSpecs.domain: legal clinic intake delayed by missing income documents
exampleSpecs.audience: clinic coordinator finding obstacle before adding appointments
exampleSpecs.stakes: more appointment slots increase backlog if documents remain missing
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: She points to the missing-doc stack and builds a pre-call checklist before opening new slots.
exampleSpecs.firstImage: A missing-document stack sits beside an appointment grid.

exampleSpecs.domain: boatyard repair project stuck behind one shared lift
exampleSpecs.stakes: skilled crews wait because the lift schedule is the constraint
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Five finished hulls wait on stands while one lift key hangs from a pegboard, naming the real delay.
exampleSpecs.firstImage: A single lift key hangs above waiting hull tags.

skillTargets: identify the controlling constraint inside a concrete scenario
choose the response that removes the bottleneck before adding effort elsewhere
reject the generic drift: A weak run would write about simplifying tasks or removing distractions rather than locating the controlling constraint.
explain the trade-off using source-specific terms rather than generic productivity language

tryThisNowSpec: Pick one stuck project and name the one obstacle that slows every other step. Do not add effort until you choose one removal move.
